blocks.text: To edit a configured segment group:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Private Access > Private Applications > Segment Groups.
If there are required fields missing, the Incomplete Configuration icon appears next to the missing item.
Locate the segment group you want to modify, and click the Edit icon.

blocks.text: The Edit Segment Group window appears.

blocks.item: In the Edit Segment Group window, make changes as necessary. To learn more about each field, see Configuring Segment Groups.

blocks.text: If you have more than 500 application segments attached to a segment group, the Clear All option is hidden. If you have 500 or fewer application segments, the Clear All option is visible.
